plainTranslation: {friendNamePossessive} Moon touches {readerPossessive} Saturn: {friendName} brings the feeling, and you bring the structure. Trust grows when you respond to {friendNamePossessive} needs with warmth as well as reliability.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.

summaryDeep: Their steadiness and your feelings settle each other. They make your emotional world feel safe and durable. This is commitment glue, so lean on it.
tension: The growth edge is learning how to offer reliability without turning every tender moment into a task. If you learned to handle everything alone or hide your needs before anyone could dismiss them, this contact may ask you to notice that defense. {friendName} does not need perfection from you. {friendName} needs warmth that can be felt.
advice: Your commitment is the gift here. Keep showing up, keep listening, and keep tending to what matters. Trust is built through practice. You and {friendName} can build something steady, grounding, and lasting when care stays visible.
summaryShort: Their steadiness and your feelings settle each other.
